question: In eukaryotes, the RNA polymerase that transcribes the transference RNA genes is:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: RNA polymerase I -> transcribes ribosomal RNA genes -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: RNA polymerase II -> transcribes messenger RNA genes -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: RNA polymerase III -> transcribes transfer RNA genes -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: RNA polymerase IV -> Unclear function in eukaryotes -> 95%
enhanced_information: In eukaryotes, the RNA polymerase that transcribes the transfer RNA genes is RNA polymerase III. analysis: Based on standard medical knowledge, the RNA polymerase that transcribes transfer RNA genes in eukaryotes is RNA polymerase III.
